title: DCL command reference
description: Document all 24 DCL built-in commands. Create docs/dcl-commands.md. For each: syntax, qualifiers, examples, VMS compatibility notes.

title: SYSUAF & rights on system disk
description: Move sysuaf.dat and rightslist.dat to system disk. Login reads from mounted volume, not initramfs.

title: Phase 8: Missing header constants (jpidef, syidef, prvdef, chfdef, msgdef, libclidef)
close_reason: Added 6 headers: jpidef.h, syidef.h, prvdef.h, chfdef.h, msgdef.h, libclidef.h. Updated starlet.h to include them.

title: First-boot experience
description: On first boot from fresh system disk: run STARTUP.COM, create default accounts if SYSUAF missing, print welcome.

title: switch_root to system disk
description: After mounting system disk, switch_root to it. ovmx_init runs from system disk. Initramfs memory freed. Initramfs shrinks to: busybox, kernel modules, init-wrapper.sh.

title: Phase 8: Conformance test harness for Eight-Cubed examples
close_reason: Conformance test harness complete: 8 tests (hello, descriptor, event_flags, fao, getmsg, math, signal, time) all passing. Runner script at tests/conformance/run_conformance.sh.

title: Define ODS-2 on-disk layout
description: Flesh out ods2.h: home block with volume label, storage bitmap header, index file header. Enough to identify volumes and store metadata. ext4 remains the storage engine underneath.

title: Phase 4: DCL Shell
description: Lexer, recursive descent parser, execution engine. 24 built-in commands. Symbol management, lexical functions, VMS file spec handling, I/O subsystem, .COM script execution, optional readline.
close_reason: Phase 4 complete. Artifacts: src/vmsdcl/ (lexer, parser, executor, dcl_builtin.c with 24 commands, symbols, lexical functions, I/O, scripts). Known debt: dcl_builtin.c is 1856 lines.

title: Phase 7: Multi-User & SSH
description: vms_login + vms_ssh_auth (PAM). SYSUAF database. Rights database. sshd configuration. Docker compose SSH on 2222. VMS login scripts. System logical names. Init script (S50ovmx).
close_reason: Phase 7 complete. Artifacts: tools/vms_login, tools/vms_ssh_auth, distro/rootfs/etc/ovmx/ (sysuaf.dat, sshd_config.ovmx, LOGIN.COM, SYLOGIN.COM, STARTUP.COM, sylogicals.conf), PAM integration, docker-compose.yml SSH on 2222.

title: Buildroot integration
description: Phase 8 candidate. Config and package stubs exist in distro/buildroot/. Complete Buildroot integration: OVMX as Buildroot package, custom defconfig, reproducible distro builds.

title: Phase 8: Missing system services (sys$forcex, sys$suspend, sys$resume, sys$setpri, sys$cancel)
close_reason: sys$forcex (SIGUSR1), sys$suspend (SIGSTOP), sys$resume (SIGCONT), sys$setpri (nice mapping), sys$cancel (stub) implemented. Build verified.

title: SYSUAF administration guide
description: Guide for managing SYSUAF: adding users, setting passwords (SHA256), assigning privileges, UIC allocation. Create docs/sysuaf-admin.md.

title: DCL SHOW DEVICE command
description: Display mounted volumes: device name, volume label, status, free space.

title: Define system disk directory layout
description: Standard VMS directory structure on system disk: [SYS0.SYSCOMMON.SYSEXE], [SYS0.SYSCOMMON.SYSLIB], [SYS0.SYSCOMMON.SYSMGR], [SYS0.SYSCOMMON.SYSHLP], [SYSMGR], [000000] MFD. Map to Linux paths.

title: Phase 8: Implement sys$synch
close_reason: Implemented sys in sys_event.c with prototype in starlet.h. Waits on event flag then returns IOSB status.

title: Initramfs disk discovery
description: init-wrapper.sh scans block devices, reads ODS-2 home block to find system disk, mounts it (block device -> ext4 -> vmsfs overlay).

title: Phase 8: Implement sys$fao / sys$faol system services
close_reason: sys$fao and sys$faol implemented with full FAO directive support: !AS, !AD, !SL/SW/SB, !UL/UW/UB, !XL/XW/XB, !OL/OW/OB, !ZL/ZW/ZB, !/, !_, !!, !n*c, !%S. Build verified.

title: API documentation: sys$ system services
description: Document all sys$ functions in src/libvms/syssvc/. Create docs/api-system-services.md. For each: signature, parameters, return values, VMS status codes, examples.

title: Phase 8: Missing RTL functions (lib$find_file, str$match_wild, str$analyze_sdesc, mth$ hyperbolic)
close_reason: lib$find_file (glob-based), lib$find_file_end, str$match_wild, str$analyze_sdesc, str$compare_multi, str$replace, mth$ hyperbolic/trig/math functions (~20+ routines). Build verified.

title: Configuration file format documentation
description: Document config formats: sysuaf.dat, ovmx.conf, sylogicals.conf, rightslist.dat. Create docs/config-formats.md. Field descriptions, examples, constraints.

title: mount_ods2 volume mounter
description: Wrapper/helper: loop-mount disk image, mount ext4 backing, overlay vmsfs.ko. Register volume in mount table.

title: Configure static analysis
description: No static analysis or linting. Set up clang-tidy and cppcheck. Integrate into CI/CD. Address findings incrementally via follow-up beads.

title: FUSE ODS-2 driver
description: Phase 8 candidate. BUILD_FUSE CMake option exists but not implemented. FUSE driver for ODS-2 filesystem format. Mount .dsk images on Linux. Read-only first, then read-write.

title: Phase 13: DECnet Phase IV userspace stack
STARTUP.COM on system disk
description: System startup runs from SYS$MANAGER:STARTUP.COM on mounted system disk, not from initramfs.

title: DCL MOUNT command
description: MOUNT DKA100: DATAVOLUME — mounts ODS-2 volume, assigns logical name, uses mount_ods2 under the hood.

title: Enhanced DCL: pipes and redirection
description: Phase 8 candidate. Add pipe support and I/O redirection. Design decision needed: VMS-style pipes (mailboxes) vs Unix-style. Document trade-offs.

title: Phase 2: System Services & RTL (libvms)
description: System services (assign, QIO, io_uring, event, time, process, memory, logical names, AST, locks, mailbox, security). RTL (lib$, str$, mth$, ots$). VMS descriptors, status codes, public headers.
close_reason: Phase 2 complete. Artifacts: src/libvms/syssvc/ (13 services), src/libvms/rtl/ (lib$, str$, mth$, ots$), descriptor support, status code infrastructure, public headers (starlet.h, descrip.h, iodef.h, lnmdef.h, prcdef.h, rmsdef.h).

title: Improve userspace test coverage
description: Kernel modules well-tested (62 assertions), userspace less so. Identify gaps in: system services (libvms/syssvc/), RTL (libvms/rtl/), RMS, DCL. Create follow-up beads for specific subsystems.

title: mkods2 volume formatter
description: CLI tool: create raw disk image, partition, format ext4, write ODS-2 home block + metadata. Output: system.dsk ready to mount.

title: Phase 9: CRTL shim + header binary compatibility audit
Split dcl_builtin.c by command group
description: src/vmsdcl/dcl_builtin.c is 1856 lines. Split by command group: file commands, directory commands, process commands, system commands. Keep dcl_builtin.c as dispatcher.

title: Phase 8: Implement sys$getmsg / sys$putmsg
close_reason: sys$getmsg (flag-controlled message formatting) and sys$putmsg (message output with action routine support) implemented. Build verified.

title: Phase 1: Syscall Layer (libvmssys)
description: Freestanding syscall wrappers, string utils, futex sync, math, crt0. x86_64 + aarch64 assembly. 7 test programs. See tracking/roadmap.md.
close_reason: Phase 1 complete. Artifacts: src/libvmssys/ (syscall.S, crt0.S, sigreturn.S for x86_64+aarch64), freestanding string/snprintf/stdio/math, kernel interface layer. 7 tests passing.

title: Phase 3: Filesystem & Logical Names
description: VMS filesystem (path translation, versioning, case, protection). Logical name manager + daemon (vmslnmd). RMS (sequential, relative, indexed). Process control blocks, ASTs, event flags.
close_reason: Phase 3 complete. Artifacts: src/vmsfs/, src/vmslnm/ + vmslnmd, src/vmsrms/ (FAB/RAB/NAM/XAB), src/vmsprocess/. RMS parse and search operations working.

title: make install-disk build target
description: Build pipeline: compile static -> create disk image -> format ODS-2 -> install OVMX -> produce system.dsk ready to boot.

title: VMS HELP content database
description: Phase 8 candidate. vms_help tool exists but help database is empty. Populate: DCL commands, sys$ functions, lib$ functions, concepts. VMS-style .HLP format or equivalent.

title: VMS device naming & device table
description: Assign VMS device names to block devices: DKA0: (system disk), DKA100:, DKB0:. Maintain device table mapping VMS names to Linux block devices.

title: Phase 8: Full Condition Handling Facility (CHF)
close_reason: Full CHF implemented: lib$establish, lib$revert, lib$signal, lib$stop, lib$sig_to_ret with thread-local handler stack. Build verified.

title: API documentation: lib$/str$/mth$/ots$ RTL
description: Document all RTL routines in src/libvms/rtl/. Create docs/api-rtl.md. For each: signature, parameters, return values, examples. Group by prefix.

title: Set up CI/CD pipeline
description: No CI/CD currently. GitHub Actions: build dev mode + static mode, run ctest, build Docker image, run integration tests. Trigger on push/PR to main.

title: Phase 5: Kernel Modules
description: vms.ko (access control, AST, event flags, lock manager). vmsfs.ko (superblock, inode, file, directory, versioning). Standalone Makefiles. QEMU test infrastructure. 5 test programs, 62 assertions.
close_reason: Phase 5 complete. Artifacts: src/kernel/vms.ko, src/kernel/vmsfs/vmsfs.ko, standalone Makefiles, tests/qemu/ infrastructure, 5 test programs with 62 assertions.

title: Dockerfile.bootable update for disk boot
description: Update bootable image to produce both initramfs AND system disk. QEMU launches with both.

title: Fallback boot to initramfs
description: If no system disk found, fall back to current initramfs-only behavior. Print: %%BOOT-W-NOSYSDISK, no system disk found.

title: Add virtio-blk disk to QEMU
description: Modify run-qemu.sh to attach system disk image as virtio block device (-drive file=system.dsk,format=raw,if=virtio).

title: DCL DISMOUNT command
description: Unmount volume, flush buffers, remove logical names.

title: Volume label & identification
description: Read/write volume label from ODS-2 home block. SHOW DEVICE displays volume label, size, free space.

title: Phase 6: Minimal Bootable Distro
description: Static musl-gcc build (OVMX_STATIC). Dockerfile.bootable. init-wrapper.sh (PID 1). ovmx_init boot orchestrator. run-qemu.sh (x86_64 + aarch64). Initramfs with busybox + kernel modules.
close_reason: Phase 6 complete. Artifacts: OVMX_STATIC CMake option, Dockerfile.bootable, init-wrapper.sh, src/ovmx_init/, distro/boot/run-qemu.sh, initramfs with busybox + kernel modules.

title: ovmx_install installer tool
description: Copy static binaries (ovmx_init, vmsdcl, vms_login, vmslnmd, vms_help), configs (sysuaf.dat, sylogicals.conf, ovmx.conf), startup scripts (STARTUP.COM, SYLOGIN.COM) onto system disk.

title: Rightslist integration into access checks
description: Phase 8 candidate. rightslist.dat exists but not fully wired into access control. Integrate into vms.ko access checks and libvms security functions.
